purpose: confirmation: within 5.5x the per-move time of S50 on the desktop GPU, does the largest budget beat the canonical S50 with the same canonical models on fresh openings? A pass names a canonical candidate only; no training, no promotion

models.note: the canonical pair (original H3 + H6 v3) on both sides

ratios.mean: mean seconds of the tested moves / mean seconds of the S50 moves, the same games
ratios.p95: 95th percentile of the tested moves / that of the S50 moves, the same games

timing.rule: the first of S400, S200, S100 with both ratios <= 5.5 is selected; none: END_NO_BUDGET; every move must carry its time and side; the scores are not read

confirm.sample_rule: h7r_openings.pick(O1-confirm-main, 300, 9111), fixed in the timing record before any confirmation game; a resumed confirmation plays only that sample

tactical.suite: the E1 dev manifest (h7c_arena.E1_MANIFEST), the budget agent and the S50 agent
tactical.comparison: exact fractions (num/den); a rate with no denominator on both sides is no regression; on one side only it is not comparable and the gate fails
tactical.not_measured: value and policy probes: the models are the same on both sides
tactical.why_not_tactical_judge: h7c_arena.tactical_judge reports E1 regressions without failing and its command refuses two sides with the same models

reading.P: score - 0.5 over the 300 pairs: STRONGER (lower > 0) / WEAKER (upper < 0) / NOT_ESTABLISHED; the class level reported
table: all of P STRONGER, no illegal move (tested 0, opponent illegal pairs 0), the E1 gate, both time ratios <= 5.5 in the confirmation games: PASS (a canonical candidate)
otherwise: END (the failed items recorded), canonical unchanged
no budget within the cap: END_NO_BUDGET
reading.scope: the selected budget against S50 only: never which budget is strongest

stages.timing: the budget selected by time only
stages.confirm: the confirmation games, the E1 gate and the judge

scope: desktop GPU; the web SER5 CPU time, certification and the canonical change are a separate promotion
